first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A is in the left-side foreground. A person with short dark hair, wearing a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves, brownish-tan pants, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, and the person's position may change with the camera shot.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. A person with relatively short gray-brown hair, wearing a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark long pants; does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by Person A's grip relationship and continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by Person B's grip relationship and continuous action; its designation does not change based on whether it is at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people's feet and between the two people, with the seams between planks extending into the distance; excludes the stairs above, the Pillar, and scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: A collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered and piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual items are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are excluded.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: A thick, upright columnar structural component indoors, visible at the side and in the background; defined separately from the slender, closely spaced rods of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: A background structure composed of the large dark wall surface, frame edges, and elevated beam rack behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Grating
entities.identification: The Grating beside the people or in the background, composed of repeated vertical rods and connecting horizontal rods, including its thicker edge rods; limited to the currently visible extent in this clip.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: The stairs in the background, composed of several horizontal steps that rise progressively, located behind the people and excluding ordinary floorboard seams.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: A collection of low rectangular box-shaped containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the areas visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: Orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; excludes the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: Bright specks and short streaks that briefly scatter near where the two swords meet, appearing and dissipating with the sword-clashing action; excludes stationary Metal Debris on the Ground and environmental Flames.
